$schema: Model generation config for the Agent Harness.
$doc: Model identity + ONE shared set of generation params, applied to every agent call (harness loop, research, job ranking, cover letter, summaries). Only the API key lives in env (LLM_API_KEY). Edit this file to tune the model. Two protocols are supported: OpenAI-flavored (openai, openai-compatible) and Anthropic-flavored (anthropic, anthropic-compatible). Both option blocks may be present simultaneously; only the one matching the active provider is applied at runtime.

params.$doc: Shared generation params used by every generateText() call across all agents.
